items.title: Physical Infrastructure: The Backbone of Daily Life
items.explanation: Physical infrastructure is a vast network of tangible structures that keep cities and villages functioning. It includes transportation systems like roads, bridges, railways, and airports; utilities such as electricity, water pipelines, and solar power projects; communication networks like internet and telephone lines; and energy sources like windmills and oil pipelines. Without this network, basic needs like reaching school, accessing markets, and receiving medical care become impossible.
